formulas.ascii: Cut gain, not the procedure: cutting tree edge e splits region R into the child side C_e and the remainder, lowering the within-region sum of squares by g_e = SSD(R) - SSD(C_e) - SSD(R \ C_e), with SSD(S) = sum_i sum_c x_ic^2 - sum_c (sum_i x_ic)^2 / n_S. Each step applies the largest gain (ties to the lowest edge slot) whose two sides both keep minimumRegionSize rows, until the target region count is reached.
